checks.name: Additive migration preserves names, bases, belongings and recipes
Two watered nights yield exactly three peppers; duplicate actions and dry days are safe
Fishing waits for a bite, records catches and settles each pending catch only once across reload
Rotating market offers persist; remote, duplicate and out-of-stock purchases cannot charge the purse
Neighbour requests require proximity, consume once, reward once and advance on different days
Beach shells can be gathered once per spot per in-game day
Home placement, storage and undo conserve inventory; rotated footprints, upgrades and player clearance are checked
Rotated models use matching collision bounds; a transaction invalidates decoration undo
Ada notices decorating, accepts shells and visits after her third story, with reload-safe placement
World additions remain finite and singular; all journal tabs and complete resume keep progress

method: Actual shipped runtime, Three.js and glTF in Node. Browser preview served, but its WebGL context was unavailable. No visual/GPU/phone claim.
